liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (1 review): The jam just before the second verse is singled out as outstanding [14]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 other source): Sugar Magnolia went into Johnny B. Goode, with no Sunshine Daydream played [6]
- This audience recording includes the encore U.S. Blues, which filled a gap in the reviewer's copy [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd80-10-06 s1t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd80-10-06 s1t02 Dire Wolf**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd80-10-06 s1t03 Cassidy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd80-10-06 s1t04 Jack-A-Roe**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd80-10-06 s1t05 Monkey & The Engineer**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd80-10-06 s1t06 I've Been All Around This World**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd80-10-06 s1t07 Heaven Help The Fool**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd80-10-06 s1t08 China Doll**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-10-06.144726.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 37 songs; 224 min [1]
- **gd1980-10-06.135936.sbd.GEMS.flac16**: soundboard; 37 songs; 174 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd80-10-06.menke.vernon.13062.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 34 songs; 221 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: Good audience recording of a tricky acoustic room; reviewer says the room sound resembles the Capitol Theatre in Port Chester, NY [14]
- **gd1980-10-06.nak700.ellner.koucky.89169.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 33 songs; 199 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience recording closely matches what the reviewer heard from the center, third row of the balcony and elsewhere in the hall [15]
- **gd1980-10-06.155950.electric.sets.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 161 min [6]
- **gd80-10-06.acoustic-sbd.8779.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 45 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [10]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended this Monday night Market Street show and calls it an easy night for local fans [15]
- A loud person near the taper announces each song title on the audience recording [22]
- This electric-sets source lacks the acoustic first set [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-10-06.144726.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII)kamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII) [1]. Also: Nakamichi 700 source from Todd Ellner and Bill Koucky patches the start of Bird Song and transitions in Terrapin Station and The Other One [1]
- **gd1980-10-06.135936.sbd.GEMS.flac16**: taped by PO and Stucco TINA Holmes; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: flac16 Soundboard > Cass > PCM Sony L-750ESX-HFB Dynamicron EXCELLENT SUPER HIFI VIDEO CASSETTE-> Sony SLO-1800 STEREO VIDEOCASSETTE RECORDER-> Sony PCM-601ESD… [3]. Also: Described as the first electric soundboard source for this date in digital circulation, with selections from October 4, 6 and 9, 1980; Source supplied by Tina Holmes; edited and mastered by Jamie Waddell as a GEMS project in June 2016 [3]
- **gd80-10-06.menke.vernon.13062.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Bob Menke?; source: Audience Recording: Nakamichi CM700's [4]. Also: Reviewer speculates the recording might be one of the Ken and Judy tapes; Taped probably by Bob Menke from center balcony with three Nakamichi CM700 mics, mixer and Sony D-5; Remastered by Douglas Ferguson from a first-generation cassette, using a JVC deck with pitch correction, then Tascam gear [4][14]
- **gd1980-10-06.nak700.ellner.koucky.89169.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ron Ellner; transferred by Bill Koucky; source: Nakamichi 700s > Sony TC D-5 > MAC > Teac Real to Reel [5]
- **gd1980-10-06.155950.electric.sets.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Wiseman and Scott Clugston; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [6]
- **gd80-10-06.acoustic-sbd.8779.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [10]. Also: The soundboard is only partial and can't be downloaded; the audience recording covers the whole show [18]
